Ongoing industrial overcapacity driving price competition.
Broad expectation of prolonged deflationary trends.

en.bull_case: Continued weak consumer confidence and property sector struggles will suppress prices well into 2026.
en.bear_case: Aggressive government stimulus or a global economic rebound could unexpectedly ignite inflationary pressures.
